end.summary:
Practised the meaning of a community: people living in one place who help and depend on one another.
Gave examples of cleaning a park, sweeping, collecting garbage, and planting trees together.
Repeated the ideas “together” and “shared” with prompts.
At the end, named family, neighbours, and shopkeepers; the full definition was not yet stated independently.
end.parentNote: Dev practised explaining what a community is and used park cleaning, garbage collection, and tree planting as examples of people helping together. The method of connecting the word to shared activities worked when Asha gave prompts, but Dev did not yet give the complete definition independently, and this was not corrected after the final response. At home, ask Dev to complete: “A community is people who live in one place and ___.”
